newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlots ship some cattle sold this week.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlots ship some cattle sold this week.

text.p: Cattle sales were light in U.S. Plains feedlots early, but sources said a small amount of cattle sold this week were shipped to meat packers Thursday.
Also, at least one packer was taking delivery this week of November contract cattle, Kansas feedlot sources said.

A few cattle sold Wednesday in Kansas were delivered Thursday, and some Oklahoma sources said animals sold Tuesday were shipped Thursday. "I sold eveything yesterday, that I had," said another Oklahoma source.
The sources said Wednesday's sales were sold about two to three weeks ahead of schedule and should be delivered Tuesday or Wednesday next week.
Selling cattle ahead of schedule should lessen the bearish price impact when more market-ready cattle are expected to become available in December, feedlot sources said.

"The numbers in December will pick up quite a bit, but we are going to sell quite a bit early," one source said. He said cash prices may dip to $67.00 to $69.00 per cwt from this week's sales at $72.00.
